title: The recall dashboard with invisible pairs

known_project_facts.project: A spare-parts distributor links vendor catalog rows to stocked physical part specifications, not interchangeable substitutes.
known_project_facts.current_pipeline: Pairs sharing a normalized manufacturer code enter scoring. Reviewers label 2400 pairs drawn only from this pool; a pair-random split reports 96% recall.
known_project_facts.observations: Acquired vendors often omit manufacturer codes, and some write package-size codes in that field. Support tickets identify valid links outside the candidate pool but are not systematically labeled.
known_project_facts.constraints: A new retrieval pass might expose many new negatives. Labeling budget is 250 entity-centered investigations. Large exhaustive cross-products are infeasible. Final deliverable is a link table; downstream substitution rules are separate.

explicitly_unknown: How representative are stock items and vendors in the labels?
What is the operational match definition for package variants?
What are recall, workload and cost targets outside the selected pool?
task: Produce a defensible project-specific ER experiment/design recommendation using selectively retrieved Atlas knowledge if available. Do not implement ER or change production. Separate facts, assumptions, uncertainties, mechanisms and proposed evidence.
